metadata.name: GetPaymentSchedule
metadata.description: This API is used to get all payment schedules added in system for an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:123654 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789632 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789654 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/CardNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: FromDateOfPayment
request_fields.description: When this date is provided, the response must only revert with the payment schedules on and after this date. Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch Default Value would be 50. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Default value would be 0 Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PaymentScheduleList
children.description: PaymentScheduleList

children.name: ScheduleID
children.description: Unique identifier for Schedule Payment.

children.name: ScheduleStatus
children.description: Schedule is created with Active status. Once payment is processed it becomes completed. When user or system deletes the scheduled payment, its status become Deleted Possible value: 1-Active 2-Completed 3-Deleted 4-Failed 5-Scheduled 6-Cancelled Instant Pay

children.name: MethodName
children.description: Method Name uniquely identifies bank accounts in Core card system. Whenever user adds any bank account. Valid Values:0-9 Example:4092

children.name: PaymentType
children.description: Type of Payment as below enumerations: 0 = Minimum Payment Due 1 = Statement Balance 2 = Current Balance 3 = Fixed Amount 4 = Adjusted Statement Balance 6 = Bi-Weekly

children.name: Frequency
children.description: Frequency set with which payment will be made. Possible values : 0-Monthly Specific Day 1-Payment Due Date 2-One Time 3-Weekly 4-Instant Pay 5-Daily 6-Bi-Weekly 7-Semi-Monthly

children.name: SpecificDay
children.description: Specific day when scheduled payment should occur. If (frequency = 0 Or frequency = 3 Or frequency = 6) and PaymentDate is not provided then this field is mandatory. If (frequency = 0) then 1-31 or EOM. If(frequency = 3 OR frequency = 6) then MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN. Allowable Values: 3

children.name: DateOfPayment
children.description: Date when payment transaction happened. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:mm Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: NextPaymentDate
children.description: Next date when payment is due. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:mm Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: PaymentAmount
children.description: Amount which will be used to schedule payment with. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.00

children.name: PaymentPosted
children.description: Number of payments posted in the schedule.

children.name: UserIdCreatedOn
children.description: Timestamp when UserID was created in the system. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: BankAccountType
children.description: Type of Bank account added by customer for card payment. Possible values 0=Checking ,1=Savings Allowable Values: 30

children.name: BAMLast4Digit
children.description: Last 4 digit of bank account number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1234 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: PaymentMode
children.description: If not provided then Default value - 0 (ACH) Possible values 0-ACH 1-Debit Card With Token 2-Debit Card With Card Number 3-APC Payment

children.name: XDaysBeforePaymentDueDate
children.description: XdaysBeforePaymentDueDate will be enabled if Frequency is "Payment Due Date". Possible Values are 0 - 28. If not provided then default values is 0 which means payment date will be Payment due Date.

children.name: PaymentReferenceId
children.description: Refernce ID of the Payment. Valid Values:0-9,A-z Example:fy76869878gh Allowable Values: 36

children.name: UserIdCreated
children.description: UserName who created payment schedule Allowable Values: 50

children.name: UserIdDeletedOn
children.description: Timestamp when User deleted scheduled payment. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: UserIdDeleted
children.description: User name who has deleted the scheduled  payment. Example : John.Doe Allowable Values: 50

children.name: BankName
children.description: Name of bank against payment method is being added which.

children.name: ApplicantType
children.description: Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values: Applicant/Co-Applicant/Cosigner Example: Applicant Allowable Values: 15

children.name: BankRoute
children.description: 9 digit field, an unique id to identify bank Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 365478963 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: PaymentEffectiveDate
children.description: Indicates actual payment schedule date considering the bank holidays and weekends. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:mm Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number will ensure that API hit our internal servers. This will always be unique. It can also be null when API is returned from our external servers Example – If we pass blank User Id and Password in input then this will be null. This ID can be used for tracking purpose of any request hit the core card internal servers
